That gives me a clearer perspective on how these nodes are connected. I need to keep this in mind as I explore further!**Exploring directed graphs**

There could be a pathway from Charles to Donald or the other way around because of those directed edges. I want to investigate if we can reach Donald starting from Charles by following the ancestor-to-descendant edges.
